svg.text: An LLM predicts the next token. How it is built (attention), trained (pre-, mid-,

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: post-training), and served (KV cache, test-time scaling) sets the cost, speed, and context

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: limits every agent has to design around.

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: LLM 的本质是预测下一个 token。它的架构（注意力）、训练方式（预训练、中期训练、后训练）和

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 推理方式（KV 缓存、测试时扩展），决定了每个智能体都要面对的成本、速度和上下文限制。
